([[Norcross, Georgia]]) | college = *[[Belmont Bruins men's basketball|Belmont]] (2019–2023) | highlights = *First-team All-[[Missouri Valley Conference|MVC]] (2023) *First-team All-[[Ohio Valley Conference|OVC]] (2022) }} '''Ben Sheppard''' (born July 16, 2001) is an American [[college basketball]] player for [[Belmont Bruins men's basketball|Belmont Bruins]] of the [[Missouri Valley Conference]]. ==Early life and high school== Sheppard grew up in Atlanta, Georgia and attended [[Greater Atlanta Christian School]] (GAC).{{cite web|url=https://www.gwinnettdailypost.com/sports/greater-atlanta-christian-grad-ben-sheppard-earns-nba-combine-invitation/article_60887004-e910-11ed-af2c-1f4b00ee9f8b.html|title=Greater Atlanta Christian grad Ben Sheppard earns NBA Combine invitation|work=[[Gwinnett Daily Post]]|date=May 2, 2023|access-date=May 17, 2023}} He averaged 13.7 points per game during his junior season as GAC won the Class AAA State Championship.{{cite web|url=https://www.gwinnettprepsports.com/sports/gac-s-ben-sheppard-commits-to-belmont-for-basketball/article_d8099fd2-7235-5c68-a233-25640764a9a8.html|title=GAC's Ben Sheppard commits to Belmont for basketball|website=GwinnettPrepSports.com|date=September 15, 2018|access-date=May 19, 2023}} ==College career== Sheppard played in 32 games averaged 2.9 points during his freshman season at Belmont. He became a starter going into his sophomore year and averages 10.5 points on the year.{{cite web|url=https://www.belmontvision.com/post/ben-sheppard-is-belmont-basketball-s-strong-and-silent-superstar|title=Ben Sheppard is Belmont basketball’s strong and silent superstar|first=Landen|last=Secrest|website=BelmontVision.com|date=February 23, 2022|access-date=May 17, 2023}} Sheppard was named first team All-[[Ohio Valley Conference]] as a junior after averaging
